name: How can I tell if a wall is load-bearing?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if a wall is load-bearing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining if a wall is load-bearing often requires professional assessment. Indicators can include walls running perpendicular to floor joists, walls located near the center of the house, or walls directly above a foundation wall or support beam in the basement. However, visual cues alone are not definitive. A structural engineer or experienced general contractor can perform an inspection to confirm its function accurately, often using architectural plans or by opening up a section of the wall for direct observation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for walls perpendicular to joists or in the house's center, but a professional assessment by a structural engineer or contractor is recommended for confirmation.
